attributes.name: Mythopoeic Sphinx
attributes.powers:
At the end of your turn, recharge this card to recharge any number of cards; after you reset your hand, you may search your deck for a spell and draw it.

Banish this card to draw a loot ally that has the Maftet or Sphinx trait from the box.

corrections.corrected_text: On the adventure card Secrets of the Sphinx, you may change the reward to “Each character gains a power feat. 1 character may recite the Mythopoeic Curse to draw the loot Mythopoeic Sphinx from the box.”
corrections.issue: The loot Mythopoeic Sphinx doesn’t seem to be given out anywhere. Is that an error?
